iran_nuclear.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
iran_nuclear.notes: Iran nuclear risk remains critical: Reuters says Tehran’s highly enriched uranium is its strongest negotiating card, IAEA-linked reporting says Kazakhstan is open to holding Iran enriched uranium, and nuclear talks are still stuck over enrichment rights. Declared 60 percent enrichment remains the technical driver; no top-level enrichment jump or device event found.

iran_conventional.name: IRAN WAR / GULF
iran_conventional.notes: Iran/Gulf conventional risk remains imminent but mixed: Washington Post and PBS reported movement toward a ceasefire or Hormuz-reopening deal, while Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Anadolu, and Crisis Group feeds keep blockade, Hormuz-control, and ship-strike risk active.

israel_lebanon.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
israel_lebanon.notes: Israel-Lebanon moved higher: Times of Israel and TRT World report school and beach closures near the border, Haaretz reports Lebanese Health Ministry casualty claims from Israeli strikes, and additional south Lebanon strike reports show operations widening while talks have not stopped combat.

turkey.name: TURKEY / EAST MED
turkey.notes: Turkey/East Mediterranean remains deterrent: required web search returned no usable results and the RSS fallback found no fresh interstate clash, official atomic warning, or crisis-level force surge. Risk decays slightly on lack of live trigger.

india.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
india.notes: India-Pakistan remains elevated: Christian Science Monitor highlights arms-race concerns and Operation Sindoor anniversary analysis keeps deterrence risk alive, but the scan found no confirmed new cross-border strike or mobilization surge.

russia.name: RUSSIA-NATO
russia.notes: Russia-NATO remains imminent by spillover and strategic-warning posture: feeds reported Putin calling atomic use a last resort after major Belarus-linked drills and Medvedev warning Europe, but no confirmed direct NATO-Russia combat exchange surfaced.

china.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
china.notes: China-Taiwan stays elevated: search results cite Beijing warning Washington over Taiwan and continued conflict-risk commentary, but no fresh blockade, amphibious surge, or official atomic warning crossed threshold.

north_korea.name: NORTH KOREA
north_korea.notes: North Korea rises within critical: South Korean and regional feeds report an unidentified projectile, multiple ballistic launches, AI-guided missile/rocket claims, and new launcher-system testing. No device event reported.

russia_ukraine.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
russia_ukraine.notes: Russia-Ukraine/NATO spillover remains the top systemic driver: fresh feeds report a Russian drone incident over Romania, warnings that Europe should expect more incidents, looming large-scale Russian assault warnings, and continuing strategic rhetoric even as negotiation language persists.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: Pakistan-Afghanistan crosses into imminent: Canberra Times reports Pakistan declaring open war as it bombs Afghan cities, Afghan International reports Taliban vows to deter future Pakistani attacks, and News On AIR reports Durand Line clashes with claimed Pakistani military casualties.

sudan.name: SUDAN / RED SEA SPILLOVER
sudan.notes: Sudan/Red Sea spillover remains critical-low by carry-forward external-backing and force-posture risk; this core-zone briefing found no new Red Sea spillover trigger.

israel_palestine.name: ISRAEL-PALESTINE / GAZA
israel_palestine.notes: Gaza auxiliary tracker held from previous state: force-use and weak off-ramp risks remain live, but this run focused the required ten-zone scan.

south_sudan_abyei.name: SOUTH SUDAN / ABYEI
south_sudan_abyei.notes: South Sudan/Abyei remains elevated and softer; no fresh trigger crossed the threshold in this core-zone briefing.
